quotes.text: Luther's pamphlets sold over 7,000 editions in five years.
Lorenzo Valla proved the Donation of Constantine was a forgery — using grammar.
Heinrich Kramer forged co-authorship and a fake Cologne endorsement for his witch-hunt manual.
Titus Oates fabricated a Catholic plot to murder the king. 22 innocent men hanged.
Benjamin Franklin forged an entire fake newspaper to seed atrocity stories into the British press.
Paul Revere altered Henry Pelham's engraving of the Boston Massacre to taint the jury pool.
